# Paths whose changes cannot affect a build or a test result. A pull request
# whose changed files all match these patterns skips the test jobs; any other
# file runs them. Each workflow also names its own files, which always run it
# even though they sit under .github/.
#
# One pattern per line: a pattern ending in /** matches everything under that
# directory, any other pattern is a shell glob on the whole path (* also
# crosses /). Lines that start with # are comments.

# Documentation and licensing.
*.md
LICENSE.txt
NOTICE
.scanoss-curations.json
doxygen/**

# Editor, formatter and container setup that CI does not use.
.gitignore
.clang-format
.clang-tidy
.clangd
docker/**

# CI configuration. A workflow's own files are listed in that workflow.
.github/**
